choices.reason: Neither outcome is designated primary and both are reported in the abstract/introduction; they concern different output definitions, with the same session and AI arm, so rules 1-5 do not separate them. Rule 6 favors dyad-level novelty because it retains the full analyzed sample, whereas human-level novelty is restricted to participants with own shortlisted ideas and excludes four treated participants.
